# Excalidraw static mirror

This directory contains the production assets from
`@excalidraw/excalidraw@0.18.0`. They are mirrored so deployments can serve the
editor assets without depending on a public CDN at runtime.

Source: <https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/tree/v0.18.0>

Excalidraw is distributed under the MIT License; see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The
`fonts/` directory contains upstream-bundled fonts that remain subject to their
respective upstream licenses. When refreshing this mirror, copy the matching
license and notice files from the upstream release as well as the assets.
